<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate">
<meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache">
<meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0">
<link rel="icon" type="image/jpeg" href="Main logo.jpg">
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="Main logo.jpg">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="Main logo.jpg">
<meta property="og:image" content="Main logo.jpg">
<title>Nickname</title>
<script>
// =======================================================
// INSTANT CONFIG LOADER & CACHE-BUSTER (Render Live Update)
// =======================================================
window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG = window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG || {};

function syncAccountLinks() {
  var siteName = (typeof website_name !== 'undefined' ? website_name : (window.website_name || (window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG && window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG.websiteName) || '')).trim();
  if (!siteName) siteName = 'Nickname';

  document.title = siteName;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-site-name]').forEach(function(el) {
    el.textContent = siteName;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-site-logo]').forEach(function(el) {
    el.alt = siteName;
  });

  var tgCh = (typeof telegram_channel_link !== 'undefined' ? telegram_channel_link : (window.telegram_channel_link || (window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG && window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG.telegramChannel) || '')).trim();
  var tgGrp = (typeof telegram_group_link !== 'undefined' ? telegram_group_link : (window.telegram_group_link || (window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG && window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG.telegramGroup) || '')).trim();
  var ytCh = (typeof youtube_channel_link !== 'undefined' ? youtube_channel_link : (window.youtube_channel_link || (window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG && window.ACCOUNT_CONFIG.youtubeChannel) || '')).trim();
